channel.title: Deco Live updates
channel.description: Updates for Deco Live on macOS.

item.description:
# Deco Live 1.0.0 (1)
Welcome to Deco Live
- Make your Mac your own with stickers on your desktop and lock screen. - Move, resize, rotate, and flip stickers to arrange them just how you like.
Create on your Mac
- Turn photos, text, and emoji into stickers with Sticker Studio. - Remove photo backgrounds, add outlines, and try different effects. - Bring Chrome, Glitter, and Holographic finishes to life as you move your pointer.
Layouts for every mood
- Create, duplicate, and name your sticker layouts. - Browse your layouts with full-screen previews, and choose which to use on your desktop and lock screen. - Use the same layout in both places, or give each its own look.
Your sticker library
- Keep your sticker library available across your devices with optional iCloud sync. - Turn iCloud on or off without restarting Deco Live. Your Mac layouts stay on your Mac.
